items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: So MORRIS Murray say, let's record it.

ctx.x: And that big trombone player, short, Black fellow, what's the name? Fuller, Fuller something, let me see the name, get back to -- so, all right, I take this fellow with me to the Birdland for two week engagement. It was a big hit. So MORRIS Murray say, let's record it. So we made an album with Herbie Mann. I made an album with Herbie Mann -- when that was made? I've got to (inaudible).

So to make the whole story short, then I'm supposed to go abroad to (THROUGH THE STATE DEPARTMENT inaudible). This when I got my lesson. I turn around, and they took Doc Cheetam from my band (inaudible).
